name: Droyne Life Events
description: Droyne do not use the standard Life Events system. Instead, a Droyne Traveller rolls 2D with their caste number as a positive DM at the end of every term. On a result of 10+, roll on this table.

2.description: You help build a prestigious starship. Choose to gain either one level in Engineer, Electronics or Mechanic, or increase rank by +1.

3.description: Your immediate Leader dies or is discredited. Make a Caste check. If you succeed, your rank is increased by +1 when you join a new Leader. If you fail, it is decreased by −1.

4.description: You gain a Black Skill. Gain one level of Carouse, Deception, Gambler, Persuade or Streetwise.

5.description: Your daily efforts are in keeping with the expectations of your Leaders. Gain a level in your Caste skill.

6.description: The Oytrip struggles through difficult times. Make a Caste skill check. If successful you suffer no ill effects. If you fail, your rank is reduced by −1.

8.description: The Oytrip prospers. Your diligent work brings you into contact with an important Leader. Make an Appeal check. If successful you gain this Leader as a Contact.

9.description: You come into contact with outsiders. Make an Outsider check. If successful, you gain an Ally from outside the Oytrip. If you fail, you gain a level of Outsider in a specialty of your choice.

10.description: You are taken on a voyage, or lead one. Gain one level in Pilot, Astrogator, Engineer or Electronics.

11.description: You are selected for advanced psionic training. Gain PSI +1.

12.description: You come into contact with Ancients technology. It is frightening but fascinating. You gain one level of Ancients Tech.
